map.专利有效期从授权日算吗？: Does the patent term run from the grant date?
map.不是，自申请日起算；授权日只影响「授权后」的保护，期限长度以申请日为起点。: No. It runs from the filing date; the grant date only affects protection after grant, while the length of the term starts from the filing date.
map.年费忘交会失效吗？: Does forgetting an annuity lapse the patent?
map.会在应缴期满日起终止，但有 6 个月滞纳期（加收滞纳金）；期满未缴则专利权终止，: Yes, it ends from the date the annuity period expires, though there is a 6-month grace period with late fees; if it remains unpaid the patent right ends, and restoration is possible only under strict conditions.
